meta.title: Purchase Contract for a material line with a contract

steps.note: Enable contract creation as required by the case.
Ensure the selectable requisition is on the Open tab.
Select an open material PR line with a valid contract.

args.goal: click Purchase Items, choose Purchase Contract, enter a valid quantity and select the valid contract for the material line, submit and verify that the contract order is created; then repeat the submission without quantity and without selecting a contract, stopping with the validation message visible

steps.note: Handle the Purchase Contract flow and both the successful and missing-field submissions, which have no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: Please enter quantity and select a contract for all line items.

steps.note: Assert the required validation message for submission without quantity or contract.
